Family & chore settings

Enter a birth date to calculate age automatically. Existing ages stay in use until you add birthdays. Weekly headings show age at the start of the selected week; each chore uses the child’s age on its scheduled day. Any-day chores use age at the start of their assigned week.

Minimum ages are editable household rules. Choose Rotate to balance weekly chore occurrences among age-eligible kids, with rotation breaking ties. Chores with fewer eligible kids are assigned first. Choose Everyone to put the chore on every age-eligible child’s chart. You can also choose a child by name for every occurrence. Minimum age applies to Rotate and Everyone. It is ignored only for assignments to a specific child. Individual assignments are counted before balancing the remaining chores.

For weekly, monthly, and quarterly chores, check Any day for a flexible day within an assigned week, or select a weekday. Monthly chores fall on the first selected weekday of the month; quarterly chores fall on the first selected weekday of Jan, Apr, Jul, or Oct. Flexible monthly and quarterly chores are automatically spread across weeks in the calendar period and appear only in their assigned week. Weeks start on Monday; only Mondays within the period are used.

When hosted, your chart is saved in shared SQLite storage and updates across devices. Opening this file directly keeps browser-only storage. Use Back up chart for an export or Restore backup to migrate your existing chart. Editing settings recalculates assignments, so print again after making changes.

Start here: make your bed, put away your own things, and take your dishes to the kitchen. These everyday habits are for everyone, in addition to the rotating chores.
